dedupe_keys.name: warmtenetten share of dwellings connected to a heat network per neighbourhood netherlands rvo

description: This data set from the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) gives, for each neighbourhood in the Netherlands, the percentage of dwellings connected to a heat network. Its source is the Statistics Netherlands (CBS) district and neighbourhood statistics on energy sources, heat network. The data.overheid.nl entry, harvested from the National Georegister, lists the data set as available and public, under CC0 1.0, last updated on 9 April 2025, with RVO as owner and contact point. Related data sets listed with it include heat networks in development, a heat network signal map by postcode, heat profile maps of current and future heat demand, solar heat installations, and a heat atlas classification of subsurface suitability for heat storage. Coverage is the Netherlands by neighbourhood. Data are free to access; the entry names the National Georegister as its source catalogue. Caveats: it is a share of dwellings, not network routes or capacities, and it inherits the CBS statistic definitions and timing. Simulation uses are identifying neighbourhoods served by district heating for heat network exposure and planning studies. Related records: data-netherlands-grid-operator-service-areas maps heat network operators.
